content:
lia: Heads-up — onboarding sample app for edge runtimes is failing on Vercel Edge and Cloudflare Workers. Seems tied to our package exports resolving to CJS for root, causing `require is not defined` in edge. Also noticed typings not picked up in editors when using the edge sample.

sam: I saw that too. Example: example/edge-sample imports `@redwood-inference/sdk` and bundle ends up with cjs wrapper. Vercel prefers ESM -> it chokes.

maria: Relatedly, auth/retry behaves differently across builds — ESM build uses fetch polyfill path while CJS uses node-fetch wrapper so retries fire twice on timeouts. We need single retry layer.

lia: Minimal repro in CI: dev-bot attached failing log below

dev-bot: CI #4821 — examples/edge-sample build
```
Error: ReferenceError: require is not defined
at file:///workspace/dist/edge/index.js:12:3
    at ModuleJob.run (internal/modules/esm/module_job.js:125:37)
```

sam: Proposed fixes:
- Single-source TS -> compile to `dist/esm` and `dist/cjs`, emit d.ts in `dist/types`.
- package.json: top-level "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" and exports mapping:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  }
}
```
This should make edge prefer the ESM entry.

maria: For types, editors sometimes ignore conditional exports. We should keep top-level "types" and add a `types` field inside each build artifact. Also add a `typesVersions` mapping for older TS.

sam: For the auth/retry duplication: extract a small runtime-agnostic retry wrapper in `packages/sdk-core/src/retry.ts` that uses an injected fetch implementation. The node entry can pass `undici` or node fetch and edge will pass global fetch. Centralize backoff logic.

lia: Agreed. Action items:
- sam: prototype exports/types changes + edge sample fix (PR)
- maria: refactor auth/retry to make runtime-agnostic and add unit tests
- tobias: add an e2e smoke sample in examples/edge-smoke for Vercel + Workers to CI matrix

tobias: I'll take the e2e. Will also add a quick checklist to the release playbook so we don't regress.

lia: thanks! I'll open the issue tracking these 3 items and link PRs. /cc @dev-bot create issue "edge-entrypoint-types-auth-parity"

dev-bot: created issue #1023 — "edge-entrypoint-types-auth-parity" and added labels: bug, sdk, edge

sam: quick note — we should also add a tiny metadata file `package.edge.json`? maybe not, prefer to keep single package.json.

maria: If we keep single package.json, add tests that run rollup/esbuild with `--format=esm` to catch bundler problems early.

lia: OK locking in plan. ping me if you need design review for the exports mapping.
